title: Complete WebviewPanel PR 4880: safe IPC, native integration, lifecycle and regression coverage
description: PR 4880 follow-up: merge current master; remove frontend navigation/content IPC; repair method IDs, panel lifecycle, desktop backends and example; add regression and native smoke coverage. Windows and GTK3 native smoke tests passed, along with Go race checks and 1226 frontend tests. macOS and current GTK4 integration require CI/reviewer validation.

title: Validate WebviewPanel on macOS and current GTK4 desktop
description: Fork CI run 33960679942 passed macOS application/asset tests, panel race tests, native smoke, production and server builds. GTK4 application/asset and race tests passed; native smoke blocked by Ubuntu runner AppArmor user-namespace permissions. Add a per-executable profile and rerun both platforms with teardown fix.

title: Prevent repeated native panel teardown when destruction races creation
description: CodeRabbit identified queued Destroy and post-create cleanup both releasing the same native view. Add a UI-thread cleanup guard and regressions for callbacks dispatched during and after creation.
close_reason: Shared UI-thread teardown guard defers release until creation finishes and prevents repeated native destruction. Both callback orderings covered by regression tests; Windows race and native smoke pass.
